notes.title: Patch Notes - June 21, 2024
notes.notes:
Hey, players! We've gotten some feedback about issues that have popped up for a few people, and our team has investigated thoroughly, tested, and found fixes for these issues.

This patch addresses the following bugs:

[list][*](Chapter 6) Fixed an issue where a guard blocking the door to the engine room does not have a conversation trigger, preventing players from progressing.[/list]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where haptics would misfire by stopping all controller haptics when the weapon is in its holster.[/list]
[list][*]Updated textures on the hand compass (objective marker).[/list]

Please let us know if you run into any issues, either by posting on our Steam Discussions page, or via [url=https://support.journeytofoundation.com/]our support page[/url].

notes.title: Day 1 Patch: Vignette, Quest Link, & More
notes.notes:
Hello players! We have released a Day 1 patch that addresses a few issues that came up from players. Please read below for more information.

[b]Vignette Setting[/b]
A few players reported that turning the vignette settings off in-game were not fully removing a vignette from the field of view. This was confirmed on at least two headsets: Meta Quest 3 and Pimax Crystal.

We have made an update to ensure that turning off the vignette in-game removes any vignette from the headset lenses.

[b]SteamUI Language[/b]
The game is available in multiple languages (fully voice acted) and on-screen subtitles. We have made an update that allows the game to read the SteamUI language if it has been set. Previously, language (when available for the game) was determined by the Windows language setting.

[b]Quest Link[/b]
We have made an update that allows Quest Link users to play the game directly without launching SteamVR.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
We have fixed some visual bugs in Chapter 5.
